title: approved-list-sign
description: An Admin's signature for one level's approved list (docs/spec/09-open-decisions.md "Signing the approved list"): the file Sign-ApprovedList.ps1 wrote, for the version the console offered. The server checks it over the exact document it offered for that level and version, with a key the agents hold, before the list goes into force. No step-up code: the signature is the Admin's confirmation, made on their own computer.

id.description: The client, site or cabinet id; null for the fleet.

version.description: The version the signature is for, as the console offered it.
